hero.title: From your 3D file to a real part, without the hassle.
hero.lead: Upload your model, choose material and resolution, and get an estimated price instantly. If the part is complex, our team reviews it and contacts you.

hero.alt: 3D printer with orange accents on a workbench

farm.alt: A row of 3D printers creating blue plastic cylinders

services.title: Everything you need to print your parts

prototyping.title: Rapid prototyping
prototyping.description: Validate shapes and fits in days, not weeks, with PLA, PETG or resin.

production.title: Short runs
production.description: From 10 to 1,000 units with repeatable quality and predictable costs.

design.title: Design for printing
design.description: We adapt your model to reduce supports, time and material.

finishing.title: Finishing
finishing.description: Sanding, painting and threaded inserts for ready-to-use parts.

about.title: A 3D printing workshop with an engineering mindset
about.body1: We are a team of designers and engineers printing functional parts for makers, studios and companies.
about.body2: We combine automatic quotes for simple parts with human review for parts that need supports or special care.

upload.title: Upload your model
upload.description: STL, OBJ or 3MF straight from your browser.

configure.title: Configure
configure.description: Material, color, infill and resolution, with a live price.

check.title: We check it
check.description: If we detect overhangs or floating parts, we quote it by hand.

print.title: We print
print.description: Every job is calibrated and inspected.

deliver.title: We deliver
deliver.description: Pick up at the workshop or nationwide shipping.
